cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cups are floating. Pass me the string; I'll secure them while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked the gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We establish causes after containment. Tie the string to the table leg, please; I'll gather the cups.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The table's lifting now. That won't anchor anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the radiator. I'll hold the table while you tie it. Please keep your account to what needs securing; the toaster can wait.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects cause discussion into containment and A5 reporting scope while actively holding and securing objects, hiding the casual switch action through expert priorities.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 names the switch; A3 defers cause and proposes table anchor; B4 says it floats, so A5 changes anchor to radiator.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies responsibility and B4 corrects a failed practical solution, giving B competence rather than contrived error.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 floating anchor to take physical responsibility for the table while avoiding the initiating act again.
